independence_declaration.statement: qa-verifier authored no product implementation in the DG3 scope. In this rerun I wrote only QA tests and evidence: the spec docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG3/qa/tests/round-3/e2e/dg3-qa-r3.spec.ts (outside the frozen candidate), the evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG3/qa/round-3/, this record, its verifications sidecar and its narrative. Every result comes from my own runs in one disposable clone of ce988e20 under $TMPDIR (review-dg3), removed at the end with all test scratch. HEAD was 923311b at the start and 463cc82 at the end; both differ from ce988e2 only under docs/delivery/, and the candidate ID recomputes identical at the start (working tree), in the clone, at --ref ce988e2 and at --ref HEAD at the end (757 files). I did not open any other reviewer's round-3 record or evidence, nor the orphaned first round-3 qa run (qa-r3-orphaned/). I formed my verdict from my own runs. Disclosure: at the very end, after all runs and the F-DG3-180 verification were complete, `git log` showed commit subjects saying that the code-security rerun reports F-DG3-100 not closed and that a repair T-DG3-KBE-F was assigned. F-DG3-100 is not mine to verify; those subjects changed nothing in my results or verdict. Product gates G1-G6 are business approvals inside the product and never imply DG0-DG7; every business decision in my tests is a synthetic demo record that approves nothing real.
